# Offline mission coverage regression: organisational inquiry

## Original directions
Explain how individual AI use affects organisational collaboration. Examine managerial authority, incentives and cross-functional workflows, including competing explanations.

## Research excerpt
The dossier has extensive evidence on model evaluation, agent architecture and prompt engineering. It mentions that managers may approve access, but contains no evidence about authority boundaries, incentives or cross-functional handoffs.

## Expected coverage assessment
### Adequately researched
- Technical implementation mechanisms (supporting detail only).

### Important dimensions neglected or lacking evidence
- Managerial authority, incentives and cross-functional workflows have no substantive evidence.

### Supporting topics displacing the original question
- Model evaluation, agent architecture and prompt engineering dominate despite the organisational directions.
